The row menu is trimmed to essentials plus one **Sorting** submenu (chat sorting and section sorting as labelled groups). Appearance, working rules, change path, and move to group stay on the Panel «Действия» menu. Project root still has **New project** and **Move**.

`chat-settings.tsx` is outside `owns_paths`, so the combined submenu is in `app.tsx`.

dispatchContext.memoryText:
- Full plugin backups use a versioned JSON payload (`kind: 'bb-project-folders-backup'`, version 1) containing settings and all 11 durable tables: folders, folder_paths, thread_places, folder_rules, project_rules, project_order, execution_defaults, session_policies, preferences, item_styles, and folder_archives. Imports preserve row IDs and run in one transaction; invalid backups and imports during an active move or archive are rejected. Transient tables (exports, pending_exports, project_moves, thread_moves, section_moves) are excluded. This adds no schema changes and preserves the existing appearance-only export/import flow.
- Execution defaults can pin a chat environment as `folder` or `worktree`. Resolve the pin nearest-first across section, ancestors, project, and global settings. A `worktree` pin preselects a managed worktree on the folder host in both New chat and the composer chip; spawn must preserve that managed-worktree selection. With no pin, keep the existing folder/section-provider behavior. Groups must never become chat environments.
- Errand, QA, and reviewer helper threads are read-only for repository files; specialists may write under `.agents/`. Writers retain full worktree access. Wait backstops report helper edits as `repo_edited` with changed files and do not revert them.
